notes: Appearance now has two controls: a dropdown to choose the design system, and colour palettes below it. They are two different decisions and until this week the app could not tell them apart.
A new card, 'Design system colours', returns to whatever palette the design system ships with — without it, choosing a palette was a one-way door.

Installing a design system is now one command. Three corrections that had to be run by hand on every incoming theme are part of the install and report what they changed; on the last drop that was 83 out-of-date names, 521 rules rescoped…
Your existing choice carries over: whatever you had selected becomes either the design system or the palette, whichever it actually was.
